input_information.SNI-DPC: features only; no reference count or labels
input_information.WANN-DPC: same prepared features plus integer non-noise reference count; no reference-label vector

snidpc_executed_source_identity.identity_scope: executed common benchmark configuration; not a new algorithm revision

configuration_history: initial diamond9 development and first freeze; revision-era sensitivity and external quality informed global revision; one final configuration shared across datasets without dataset-specific parameter selection

preprocessing.artificial: registered numerical representation; original 21 retain raw coordinate columns
preprocessing.real: fixed encoding and missing-value handling; per-feature z-score; constant/nonfinite standardized entries set to zero
preprocessing.shared_input: identical prepared features and row order within each dataset

evaluation.output_count: all distinct nonnegative predicted labels over all input rows

comparator_calls.Gravity: registered GNaN--DSNGCAP pipeline; no reference count
comparator_calls.LDCC: scale=10 for n<500, otherwise 100; no reference count
comparator_calls.DPC-MFP: fixed public defaults k=42,l=19; no reference count
comparator_calls.WANN-DPC: integer non-noise reference count; bypass additional internal Min-Max; reference-label-free terminal-cycle safeguard

wann_cycle_guard.rule: a repeated unlabelled target inherits the predicted class of the nearest currently labelled sample; propagate to pending chain

wann_existing_common_settings.neighbor_limit_scope: retain native data-dependent clipping; no new parameter selection

resource_scope: archived six-method observations plus separately timed single-worker WANN real-data calls; no new resource benchmark
record_scope: evaluation controls and input identities; not a complete executable third-party rerun package
algorithm_source_location: src/sni_dpc/ and frozen/; source/package revision unchanged by statistical release
